description:
Biogeochemically coupled (BGC) version of esm-flat10. Driven by prescribed CO2 concentration taken from the esm-flat10 of the ESM (i.e. the carbon cycle only 'sees' the increase in atmospheric carbon dioxide, not any change in temperature). All other conditions are kept the same as piControl.".

This provides the opportunity to diagnose climate-carbon cycle feedbacks from the flat10 simulations by having a BGC variant with identical CO2 concentration. It partners the flat10-rad variant.
branch_information: this experiment should run exactly parallel to the esm-flat10 simulation, branching from the same point of esm-piControl. It should run for 150 years using prescribed CO2 concentration taken from the ESM's esm-flat10 simulation, run in BGC mode (only carbon cycle sees changing CO2).
